description: Automatic Remem recall, durable memory, checkpoints, and rollups

hooks.command: python3 -I -c 'import os,runpy,sys;root=sys.argv.pop(1);root=root if root and not root.startswith("$") else os.environ.get("PLUGIN_ROOT") or os.getcwd();root=os.path.abspath(root);scripts=os.path.join(root,"scripts");entry=os.path.join(scripts,"remem_memory_hook.py");sys.path.insert(0,scripts);sys.argv=[entry,*sys.argv[1:]];runpy.run_path(entry,run_name="__main__")' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --mode user_prompt_submit
